{
  "phoneNote": "The oversized canopy crop delays the introduction and shows mostly foliage rather than the restaurant, despite the polished typography and colours.",
  "desktopNote": "The photography and restrained green-and-gold styling suit the gostilna, but the low-positioned hero panel leaves the reservation button cut off in the first screen.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Move the hero panel upward and reduce its vertical padding so the complete introduction and reservation action fit comfortably within the first screen on both viewports.",
    "Give the phone hero its own shorter, wider photo crop that shows the facade or terrace instead of dedicating most of the exposed image to foliage.",
    "Reduce the oversized dish circles and gaps between menu items on phones, keeping each photograph, dish name and price together in a more compact block."
  ]
}
